crossRefs.note: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must…
It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them; that they may each return from…
But Jeremiah said, “They won’t deliver you. Obey, I beg you, Yahweh’s voice, in that which I speak to you; so it will…
If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
Tell them, ‘ “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked…
Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way; that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do…
Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and…
if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turns from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do…
‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck…
So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.
For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that…
When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies…
Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to…
Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”
He prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please, Yahweh, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I…

translations.web: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey Yahweh your God’s voice; then Yahweh will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.
translations.bsb: So now, correct your ways and deeds, and obey the voice of the LORD your God, so that He might relent of the disaster He has pronounced against you.
translations.kjv: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced
translations.asv: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of Jehovah your God; and Jehovah will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
